description: This file contains tests for error classification and handling functions related to Microsoft Teams API errors, including functions for categorizing errors, generating hints, and handling revoked proxies.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for 'msteams errors'.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts that a value matches a specified condition or value.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases within the test suite.

methods.name: vi.fn
methods.description: Creates a mock function for testing purposes.

methods.name: classifyMSTeamsSendError
methods.description: Classifies errors based on status code and response content into categories like 'auth', 'permanent', 'throttled', and 'transient'.

methods.name: formatMSTeamsSendErrorHint
methods.description: Generates user-friendly hints based on the error classification.

methods.name: formatUnknownError
methods.description: Formats unknown or null errors into string representations.

methods.name: isRevokedProxyError
methods.description: Detects if an error is a specifically revoked proxy TypeError.

methods.name: withRevokedProxyFallback
methods.description: Executes a function with fallback handling when a revoked proxy TypeError occurs.
